psychological_meaning: Sky Blue evokes feelings of calmness, serenity, and peace. It is often associated with open spaces, freedom, and intuition. This color can promote relaxation and reduce stress, making it a popular choice for creating a tranquil environment. Sky Blue also symbolizes loyalty, trust, and intelligence, encouraging clarity of thought and communication.
